name: Cancer
overview: Scripture assures believers that God is intimately involved in their healing and restoration, even amid serious afflictions like cancer. The Lord promises to strengthen and uphold His people, offering peace and hope for a future beyond present suffering. He sends His word to heal and deliver from destruction, affirming His power to restore health and heal wounds. This hope is especially vital for those facing breast cancer and other illnesses, reminding them of God's faithful presence and healing promises.
